items.name: Lamello P-System profile groove (common to Clamex P, Tenso P, Bisco P, Divario P-18 groove element)
articles: 132148 P-System groove cutter CNC, DP, Ø 100.4 × 7 × Ø 35 mm, Z3 (listed for Morbidelli cx110 / cx220, Brema Eko 2.1, Masterwood TF 100, Format4 D-Jet)
132142 groove cutter CNC DP Ø 100.4 × 7 × Ø 30 Z3
131342 P-System shank tool cutter, HW solid, Ø 7.05/9.8 mm, S Ø 12 × 40 mm, L 80 mm
131556 Clamex CNC drill bit HW Ø 6 mm, shaft Ø 10 × 65 mm, L 100 mm

drilling.position: P-14: disc-cutter plunge to 14 mm, giving ~69.6 mm chord at the surface; groove 7 mm wide with 9.8 mm undercut profile
P-10: plunge 10 mm, ~60.3 mm chord at the surface

rules: Lamello recommends making all profile grooves with a disc cutter (precision, tool life, machining time); a shank tool or contour cutter only for surface machining when no angle aggregate is available (brochure p. 69).
On automatically swivelling aggregates (Benz FLEX5+C / 5-MOTION PLUS) the profile groove depth in the centre of the surface is limited to 10 mm (p. 62).
Groove lengths ~69.6 / ~60.3 mm are labelled with '~' on the 1:1 drawings.

sources.what: pp. 68-69 CNC tools (cutter/shank tool/drill dims, Morbidelli cutter 132148); pp. 70-75 1:1 drawings (7 / 9.8 mm profile, 14/10 mm depth, ~69.6/~60.3 mm chord, Ø100.4); p. 62 surface depth limit

items.notes: Undercut 30° flanks are visible on the shank-tool drawing (p. 69) but the full rib profile is not dimensioned beyond 7 / 9.8 mm. The groove sits on the panel edge (butt/mitre) or on the face (surface groove).

items.name: Lamello Clamex P-14 (detachable connector with lever)

drilling.position: part A (lever-less side) and part B (lever side): 14 mm deep P-System groove; groove centred in board thickness for 19 mm (X1 = X2 = 9.5 mm in the configurator example)
part B: access hole axis 7.5 mm from the joint face (panel edge), at the groove centre along the joint; drilled from the inside face into the groove

rules: First connector centre ≥ 37 mm from the panel end; ≤ 300 mm between connectors (installation pictogram, step 2).
Butt joints from 15 mm, mitre joints from 18 mm (product text and overview p. 86); centre panel with connectors from both sides ≥ 29 mm; the part grooved on its face ≥ 12 mm (p. 86 table, column 1).
Lever and actuating key go through the Ø6 access hole; a CNC version takes a Ø5 hole (see lamello-clamex-p14-cnc).

sources.what: pp. 10-11 product page and installation pictograms (14 mm, 7.5 mm, Ø6, min. 37 / max. 300 mm, technical data); p. 71 1:1 drawing; p. 70 configurator screenshot X1/X2 = 9.5/9.5 (CNC); p. 86 overview (min. thicknesses, article numbers)
product page: Ø 6 mm opening, 64 × 27 × 9.7 mm, thickness figures

items.notes: The 9.5 mm groove offset is read from a small configurator screenshot (p. 70) and is medium confidence; the configurator itself (lamello.com) gives the exact position per joint. The column meaning of the p. 86 thickness table comes from pictograms; 15 butt / 18 mitre are also stated in words. An earlier '12 mm butt' figure belonged to Clamex P-10. The access-hole depth is not dimensioned (it runs down to the groove).

items.name: Lamello Cabineo 8 (one-piece cabinet connector, surface machining only)

drilling.position: pocket in the face of the part that carries the connector: 3 overlapping Ø15 bores, centres 3.6, 14.8 and 26.0 mm from the panel end (joint face), on one line perpendicular to the end

mating panel (e.g. the side), in its face where the end of the pocket panel butts against it: hole axis 5 mm from the pocket panel's open face, i.e. D-5 mm from its other face, where D is the pocket panel thickness; depth X = 8 mm

rules: Connector axis ≥ 20 mm from the panel edge; ≤ 300 mm between connectors (installation pictogram).
Alternative pocket with a Ø10 cutter: outline 26 mm long, 14.8 mm and 3.6 mm stations; with a Ø12 cutter: 26 / 14.8 mm (drawing p. 32).
Flush installation: pocket 11.5 mm deep with a 0.8 mm recess, 16.7 mm wide (p. 32).

sources.what: pp. 10-11 Cabineo 8 product page (screw 8 mm, drill Ø5 and Ø15, cutter ≤ Ø12, min. thicknesses, min. 20 / max. 300); pp. 32-33 'Machining Cabineo' drawings (11 mm, 3 × Ø15 at 3.6 / 11.2 / 11.2 mm, X = 8, 5 mm / D-5 mm)

items.notes: Corner joint per the p. 32 section: the pocket panel's end meets the mating panel's face. The connector screw goes into a Ø5 hole in that face. The pocket is milled in the pocket panel's inner face and opens at its end.
